title: Evaluación del Potencial de LLM (ChatGPT-4) como Métrica Objetiva para la Calidad de Imagen en CT de Mama

live_model.evidence: Sec. 2: "se evaluó el desempeño de un LLM: GPT-4-turbo (OpenAI, versión del modelo: gpt-4-2024-04-09) en comparación con seis observadores humanos..."

prompt.location: Sec. 2 (training prompt shown in Fig. 2; full evaluation prompt quoted verbatim)
prompt.note: Both the 6-image training prompt and the 50-image evaluation prompt are quoted in the paper.

claim.metric: Cohen's kappa agreement vs. human observers (qualitative summary: 'slight to acceptable agreement in >=60% of comparisons')
claim.location: Fig. 3a-3f (kappa values shown only graphically as bar charts, not as printed numbers)

data.source: Custom-simulated numerical breast-CT phantom images (100 generated via SART-TV reconstruction); not stated as released

notes: Exemplary prompt documentation (full verbatim training and evaluation prompts) and a clean n=50 test set, but the phantom CT image set is custom-generated and not stated as public/released, and exact kappa values are shown only in bar-chart figures rather than printed as text/table numbers.
